Exit code is non-zero if file missing
plan: Modify a.py to implement a script that reads and prints the exact contents of soumya.py to stdout. If soumya.py exists, print its full contents and exit with code 0. If soumya.py is missing (FileNotFoundError or equivalent), print nothing to stdout (keep it empty) and exit with a non-zero code (e.g., sys.exit(1)). Use built-in file I/O (open) in text mode with default encoding to read the file so stdout exactly matches the file's content. No additional files are needed — the entire logic lives in a.py.
code_diff:
--- a/a.py
+++ b/a.py
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
 print("a")
-
 
+import sys
+try:
+    with open("soumya.py", "r") as f:
+        print(f.read(), end="")
+    sys.exit(0)
+except FileNotFoundError:
+    sys.exit(1)
